segments.text: 18-річний Джордж-молодший їхав рідним містом додому на вечерю.
segments.original: An 18-year-old boy named George Jr. drove through his hometown on his way home for dinner.

segments.text: Але у той момент, коли він їхав, Джорджу-молодшому зовсім не хотілося їхати додому
segments.original: But, as he was driving, George Jr. could not help but feel like he was really dreading actually getting there.

segments.text: Джордж-молодший був розумним хлопцем, але він також легко відволікався і через це, він майже нічого серйозно не робив, окрім автомобілів
segments.original: So George Jr. was a very smart kid, but he also got distracted really easily and because of that, he really had not pursued anything all that seriously that is except for cars.

segments.text: І в той момент його батько купив йому італійський Фіат,
segments.original: And at that point his father actually bought him a small Italian car called the Fiat,

segments.text: але батько його, хоч подарував йому Фіат, він не розумів потягу сина, «Чому ти не можеш зосередитися на цьому і застосувати це до інших речей, отримаєш справжню роботу».
segments.original: but his father, despite being the one who literally gave him the Fiat, he just didn't get his son's obsession with cars, like why aren't you able to take that focus and apply it to other things, so we'll get your real job.

segments.text: Тож кожна вечеря в ці дні перетворювалася на величезну сварку між батьком і сином.
segments.original: And so basically every dinner these days, if he came this huge argument between father and son.

segments.text: І він під'їхав до перехрестя, яке було прямо біля його будинку, і він почав повертати, коли почув дуже гучний скрип, а потім все потемніло.
segments.original: And so George, he came to this intersection where it was right near his home, and he begins making the turn when he hears this really loud screeching sound and then everything went black.

segments.text: Через два тижні Джордж-молодший лежав у реанімації місцевої лікарні
segments.original: Two weeks later, George Jr. was laying in a hospital bed in the intensive care unit at the local hospital.

segments.text: Два тижні раніше, коли Джордж повертав, а потім щось відбулося, а саме — інший автомобіль на великій швидкості промчав дорогою і врізався в машину Джорджа так сильно, що Джордж-молодший вилетів з машини, але вижив
segments.original: So two weeks earlier when George was making that turn and then something happened, well what it was is another car can speeding down the road and smashed into George's car so hard that George Jr. was ejected from the car but he had survived.

segments.text: Через два роки Джордж-молодший, який уже повністю одужав, стояв на фініші треку з камерою
segments.original: Two years later, George Jr. who by this point was fully recovered from his injuries, stood at the finish line at a race track and raised his camera.

segments.text: Після майже смертельного досвіду, Джордж-молодший зрозумів, що його батько мав рацію: місцями він марнував свій потенціал
segments.original: So since his near-death experience, George Jr. had realized that really has dad had been kind of right that in some ways he was wasting his potential.

segments.text: Тож Джордж-молодший вирішив, що він не хоче займатися автогонками
segments.original: So George Jr. had decided that he really didn't want to race cars anymore.

segments.text: Замість цього він узяв камеру і захопився своїм колишнім хобі — фотографією
segments.original: Instead, he had picked up this camera and really gotten back into his old hobby of photography.

segments.text: Насправді Джордж-молодший подав заявку на престижну програму кінематографії в Ю Ес Сі,
segments.original: In fact, George Jr. had applied to the prestigious cinematography program at the University of Southern California,

segments.text: але після того, як надіслав заявку був майже впевнений, що його не візьмуть
segments.original: but after sending off his application, he was pretty sure he would not get in.

segments.text: Тепер Джордж-молодший пішов до подіуму сфотографувати переможця
segments.original: Now, George Jr. walked over to the podium to take some photos of the winning drive.

segments.text: Поки він ішов туди, чоловік середнього віку прийшов назустріч йому і заговорив із Джорджем-молодшим про фотографію, а потім чоловік офіційно представився як Хаскелл Векслер
segments.original: But as he walked over there, the smithelaged man came up beside him and just asked George Jr. about his photography and then at some point the man actually formally introduced himself as Haskell Wexler.

segments.text: Він сказав, що був кінооператором в Голлівуді. Джордж-молодший розповів Хаскеллу, що нещодавно подав заявку до Ю Ес Сі, щоб спробувати потрапити в програму кінематографії
segments.original: And he said that he was actually a cinematographer in Hollywood. And George Jr. told Haskell about how he had recently applied to USC to try to get into their cinematography program.

segments.text: Хаскелл сказав: Джордж, я знаю людей в Ю Ес Сі
segments.original: And when Haskell heard this, he said, George, I know people at USC.

segments.text: Я зроблю кілька дзвінків. І справді, незабаром після цієї доленосної зустрічі, Джордж-молодший отримав лист про зарахування з кіношколи Ю Ес Сі.
segments.original: Let me make some calls. And sure enough, not long after this fateful meeting, George Jr. would receive an acceptance letter from USC's film school.

segments.text: Але цей момент у житті Джорджа-молодшого не просто змінив його життя назавжди
segments.original: But this moment in George Jr's life did not just alter George's life forever.

segments.text: Це також назавжди змінить кіно. А через 13 років, Джордж-молодший створить один з найбільш новаторських фільмів в історії
segments.original: It also would go on to completely alter cinema in general forever. Because about 13 years later, George Jr. would go on to create one of the most groundbreaking films in history.

segments.text: Його фільм стане частиною найбільш успішної кінофраншизи всіх часів
segments.original: His movie would go on to become part of the most successful movie franchise of all time.

segments.text: Сьогодні Джорджа-молодшого знають як Джорджа Лукаса і його кінофраншиза — це «Зоряні війни».
segments.original: George Jr. is better known today as George Lucas and his film franchise will star wars.

source_segments: An 18-year-old boy named George Jr. drove through his hometown on his way home for dinner.
But, as he was driving, George Jr. could not help but feel like he was really dreading actually getting there.
So George Jr. was a very smart kid, but he also got distracted really easily and because of that, he really had not pursued anything all that seriously that is except for cars.
And at that point his father actually bought him a small Italian car called the Fiat,

but his father, despite being the one who literally gave him the Fiat, he just didn't get his son's obsession with cars, like why aren't you able to take that focus and apply it to other things, so we'll get your real job.
And so basically every dinner these days, if he came this huge argument between father and son.
And so George, he came to this intersection where it was right near his home, and he begins making the turn when he hears this really loud screeching sound and then everything went black.
Two weeks later, George Jr. was laying in a hospital bed in the intensive care unit at the local hospital.

So two weeks earlier when George was making that turn and then something happened, well what it was is another car can speeding down the road and smashed into George's car so hard that George Jr. was ejected from the car but he had survived.
Two years later, George Jr. who by this point was fully recovered from his injuries, stood at the finish line at a race track and raised his camera.
So since his near-death experience, George Jr. had realized that really has dad had been kind of right that in some ways he was wasting his potential.
So George Jr. had decided that he really didn't want to race cars anymore.
Instead, he had picked up this camera and really gotten back into his old hobby of photography.
In fact, George Jr. had applied to the prestigious cinematography program at the University of Southern California,
but after sending off his application, he was pretty sure he would not get in.
Now, George Jr. walked over to the podium to take some photos of the winning drive.

But as he walked over there, the smithelaged man came up beside him and just asked George Jr. about his photography and then at some point the man actually formally introduced himself as Haskell Wexler.
And he said that he was actually a cinematographer in Hollywood. And George Jr. told Haskell about how he had recently applied to USC to try to get into their cinematography program.
And when Haskell heard this, he said, George, I know people at USC.
Let me make some calls. And sure enough, not long after this fateful meeting, George Jr. would receive an acceptance letter from USC's film school.
But this moment in George Jr's life did not just alter George's life forever.
It also would go on to completely alter cinema in general forever. Because about 13 years later, George Jr. would go on to create one of the most groundbreaking films in history.
His movie would go on to become part of the most successful movie franchise of all time.
George Jr. is better known today as George Lucas and his film franchise will star wars.
